name: B2B SaaS founders
summary: Lanternfield Automation builds AI automations for early-stage B2B software companies: support triage, onboarding flows, CRM hygiene, investor and board reporting. Buyers are founders and first ops hires at companies with paying customers and a small team.

industries.b2b_saas: A software-as-a-service company selling to businesses on subscription
industries.developer_tools: APIs, infrastructure, developer platforms or open-source companies with a commercial offering
industries.vertical_software: Software built for one industry (legal tech, prop tech, health tech, logistics software)
industries.marketplace_or_platform: A two-sided marketplace or platform business with a B2B side

geography: Europe and North America; remote teams anywhere

cto_or_head_of_engineering.description: CTO, VP engineering or technical co-founder

head_of_operations.description: COO, chief of staff, head of operations or first ops hire

head_of_customer_success.description: Head of customer success, support lead or onboarding manager

support_overload.description: The support inbox or chat is overwhelming; founders or engineers answer tickets themselves

manual_onboarding.description: New customers are onboarded by hand: setup calls, data imports, configuration done manually

crm_hygiene.description: CRM data is stale or inconsistent; pipeline reviews and forecasts are unreliable

investor_reporting.description: Investor updates, board decks and metrics reporting take days each month

lead_followup.description: Trials, demo requests or inbound leads are followed up late or inconsistently

disqualifiers.pre_product: No product yet, pre-launch idea stage, or explicitly no paying customers
disqualifiers.enterprise: A large corporation with hundreds or thousands of employees
disqualifiers.competitor: The company builds AI automation, AI agents or automation consulting for other companies
disqualifiers.student_or_academic: A student, researcher, journalist or job seeker asking for an interview, thesis input or a job

intent_signals: asks for a call or proposal

warm.label: SDR sequence A
warm.action: 3-step sequence with the SaaS case study

nurture.label: Nurture track
nurture.action: Founder newsletter and the SaaS ops content track
